operational_rules: Discover, index, classify, extract, preserve, dependency-map, maturity-score, and schedule Plenra-related chats

Extract only operational artifacts: infrastructure, schemas, prompts, validation rules, deterministic logic, dependency rules, fail-closed rules, replay requirements, orchestration logic, routing logic, execution tasks, Codex tasks, acceptance criteria
Ignore casual conversation, emotional commentary, brainstorming noise, repeated explanations, non-operational text
Fail-closed: missing source_chat_id returns HOLD, incomplete extraction returns HOLD, missing dependency map returns HOLD
Maturity scoring blocks READY_FOR_CODEX when validation requirements or fail-closed logic missing
Canon preservation uses existing hashManager and canonWriter, does not overwrite without lineage
External backup registry tracks P0/P1 preservation completeness
Coverage audit sets HIGH confidence only when all known chats scanned, artifacts indexed, P0/P1 preserved, dependency graph synchronized, Canon synchronized, Codex queue synchronized
acceptance_criteria: Chat discovery cycle processes chats, extracts artifacts, preserves to Canon, emits memory events, updates dependencies, queues Codex tasks
Coverage confidence HIGH when preservation complete
Dependency mapping blocks incomplete foundational artifacts
fail_closed_rules: Missing Canon preservation keeps coverage PARTIAL
Missing backup for P0/P1 blocks dependent systems
Replay lineage failure blocks autonomous scheduling
